ui.title: Onboarding Document Checker
ui.tagline: Checks a new customer's onboarding file end to end: extracts the details from the documents, verifies identity and screens sanctions alongside a policy check, and routes the file - approve, ask the customer for what is missing, or send it to an officer.

actions.label: Run: Onboarding document check
actions.description: A new customer application arrives. Kaman extracts the applicant's details from the documents, verifies identity and screens sanctions in parallel with a policy check, then routes: clean files are approved, mismatches go to an onboarding officer, missing documents are requested from the customer.
